scope: Read-only independent audit of the six existing H05 actual research runs. Original presealed plans, completed and failed outcomes, protocol and criteria are preserved. No engine execution, code/profile injection, product receipt submission or plan correction is performed.

standalone_facts.fact: The final coherent research set completes all five legal Black replies at the exact late 43.g4, all six White choices after each of four king replies, and all eight after ...f5, at d24 with explicit Threads2/Hash128 and Clear Hash before each query.
Kf5 is legal and winning after all four king replies; each inventory also has five other winning choices. It is not proven unique or necessary.
...f5 is the fifth legal defense and Kf5 is illegal after it. The complete eight-move inventory gives exf5+ mate13, e5 cp0 and six other moves cp8115.

The six coherent successful h128 queries took 481190ms (8m1.190s). Across all twenty attempts in these six runs, eleven completed attempts took 677739ms (11m17.739s), nine failed attempts took 4732710ms (78m52.710s), total 5410449ms (90m10.449s). These are per-query elapsed sums, not agent-duration, CPU-time, bill or production-latency measures.

The separate h16 original-root comparison completed all nine legal choices at d20/d24: early g4 cp0, Ke3 cp316/cp471. The late seventeen-ply branch starts Ke3 and is conditional. Its completed replies do not establish the whole cause of the root grade.

Both f5 inventory plans copied illegal Kf5/six-move display metadata, but their actual presealed work, exact position, sent searchmoves, MultiPV8 and returned full eight-move outcomes are correct. The metadata error is flagged, never silently corrected or used as evidence that Kf5 was tested after ...f5.
